blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — At least four armed men were killed during air and artillery attacks beginning at 9 a.m. on Saturday in Tugunan town in the Bangsamoro region’s Special Geographic Area. Tugunan Mayor Abdullah Abas said the slain armed men were linked to kidnapping, carnapping and murder.
